title: A flagged customer is deleted or refused by the same rules as any customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer with no work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, flagged as an Internal customer, with one open internal work order, so a refused delete can be seen.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, not flagged, with one open billable work order, so today's refusal can be seen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Delete customer A.
  3. Open customer C's page.
  4. Delete customer C.
  5. Open customer B's page.
  6. Delete customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is deleted and is no longer in the Customers list.

Step 3:

  • Customer C's page opens.

Step 4:

  • The delete is refused because customer C has an open work order; note the message.

Step 5:

  • Customer B's page opens.

Step 6:

  • The delete is refused with the same message as for customer C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-E2: “If a flagged customer is deleted, its flag goes with it; nothing else changes. Deleting a customer with open work orders is refused as today.”
